title: Acme app — checks for you
heading: Checks only you can run
intro_html: Most important first. Mark each one, then Copy my results and paste back.

qa.check: Delete an item that has an attachment
qa.why_html: Expected: it deletes cleanly. Before this release it raised an error and left the attachment behind.

qa.check: Open an inspection on your phone and tap a photo
qa.why_html: Expected: the thumbnail shows, and tapping it zooms. Depends on qa-delete-item passing first. I could not test this here: no phone browser.
qa.notes_label: Paste the image URL if it failed
